purpose: Compact navigation index for the supplied JavaScript::D3 signatures. Consult subs.json for exact overloads and defaults.

configuration.name: js-d3-config
configuration.use: Return JavaScript to prime a Jupyter frontend with D3 before rendering :format<jupyter> output.

format.meaning: Choose code for a Jupyter frontend, a complete standalone HTML document, an embeddable HTML fragment, or unwrapped JavaScript. Support varies by routine; confirm in subs.json.

shared_output_options.div-id: Optional target element identifier, especially important for HTML output or multiple plots.

charts.name: js-d3-bar-chart
charts.data: numeric positional data, pairs, a hash, or Map records

charts.name: js-d3-bubble-chart
charts.data: 2-, 3-, or 4-column positional data or Map records using x/y/z

charts.name: js-d3-density2d-chart
charts.data: pairs/lists or Map records using x/y

plots.name: js-d3-list-line-plot
plots.data: numeric values, 2- or 3-column positional data, or Map records

plots.name: js-d3-date-list-plot
plots.data: numeric values, date/value lists, a string time series, or pairs

plots.name: js-d3-heatmap-plot
plots.data: 2- or 3-column positional data or Map records

plots.name: js-d3-list-point-plot3d
plots.data: 3- or 4-column positional data or Map records

specialized_visualizations.name: js-d3-graph-plot
specialized_visualizations.data: edge pairs, 2- to 4-column positional data, or Map records

specialized_visualizations.name: js-d3-chessboard
specialized_visualizations.data: a string, strings, three-column positional data, Map records, or defaults

specialized_visualizations.name: js-d3-clock-gauge
specialized_visualizations.data: a DateTime, hour/minute/second, or named time fields

specialized_visualizations.name: js-d3-random-koch-curve
specialized_visualizations.data: a generated or supplied point sequence with distributions and iteration count
